title: Homestake experiment
excerpt: Homestake Gold Mine, Lead, South Dakota, 1,478 m (4,850 ft) underground; 380 m3 (100,000 gallon) tank of perchloroethylene; operated continuously 1970-1994; headed by Raymond Davis Jr. and John N. Bahcall; Davis's experiment turned up only one third of Bahcall's predicted figure.
